title: The Ancient Ruins Emerge
next_chapter_hook: The whispers from behind the ancient stone door seemed to call Chen Ji's name—a name he had never heard, yet was etched deep within his bloodline.

text.content: The aftershocks of the temporal rift receded like a tide, and upon the ruins of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, the air hung thick with the intertwined scents of scorching and chaos. Chen Ji knelt on one knee, cold sweat beading on his brow. The backlash from the Heavenly Secrets Technique had burned his internal organs as if by fire. Yet just as he forced himself to stand, the earth beneath his feet suddenly trembled with an uncanny vibration.

Su Qingyao rushed forward, grasping Chen Ji's arm. Her usually cold and proud face now bore a rare hint of worry, her clear eyes reflecting Chen Ji's ashen complexion. She had clearly been three zhang away moments ago, yet had somehow arrived at his side—the speed of her movement was顶尖 among the Inner Disciple Senior Fellows.

dialogue.content: (Forcing a faint smile) Thank you for your concern, Su Senior Sister. It is merely a minor backlash; I can endure.

text.content: Yet before the words finished, the ground trembled violently once more. A ghostly blue radiance shot upward from the ruins' depths, and within that glow, the vague silhouette of a grand hall slowly materialized. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—that was the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion Ruins! The Tianji Record Fragment within him quivered violently, as if sensing some long-lost call.

dialogue.content: This aura... something is wrong! How can there be ruins of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion here?

text.content: Su Qingyao's voice carried distinct wariness. As an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of vast experience, she naturally knew what the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion represented in legend—it was a forbidden land from ancient times dedicated to deducing Heavenly Secrets and gazing upon the Heavenly Dao, supposedly destroyed in a cataclysm ten thousand years ago. Yet now these ruins manifested amid the aftershocks of the temporal rift—the strangeness was anything but ordinary.

Chen Ji did not answer. His gaze fixed intently upon that ghostly blue light, faint runes swirling in the depths of his pupils. It was a resonance from deep within his bloodline, as if something long dormant was awakening within him. That feeling was both foreign and familiar, like a long-awaited reunion, yet also fated. The Tianji Record Fragment quivered madly in his Mental Sea, seemingly urging him forward.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, have you gone mad? These ruins just manifested—who knows what dangers lie within!

text.content: Su Qingyao seized Chen Ji's sleeve, halting his forward steps. Her fingers tightened slightly, her knuckles whitening from excessive worry. In this moment, she was no longer the lofty Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, but merely an ordinary woman concerned for her companion's safety. Yet Chen Ji's gaze—calm to the point of cold indifference—caused an inexplicable chill in her heart.

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Secrets Pavilion Ruins lay right before him, and the call from the Tianji Record Fragment within grew ever more intense. Su Qingyao's warnings still echoed in his ears, yet the resonance from deep within his bloodline surged like a tide.

choices.description: The bloodline's call is irresistible; one must immediately enter the ruins to uncover the truth. This opportunity will not wait; time will not repeat.
choices.visible_reward: Clues to the Fourth Page of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The Ruins Are Beset with Perils at Every Turn

dialogue.content: (Gently brushing aside Su Qingyao's hand) Su Senior Sister, my mind is made up.

text.content: Chen Ji's voice remained impassive, yet within those eyes burned a fierce light. He strode forward toward that ghostly blue glow. Each step felt as if he were stepping upon the pulse of destiny. Su Qingyao wished to stop him again, but when she met Chen Ji's gaze, she found herself utterly unable to speak.

choices.memory_label: 陈机展现了异常的决断力

choices.description: First observe the entrance to the ruins, wait for the opportune moment to delve deeper, ensuring nothing goes wrong.
choices.risk_hint: The Ruins May Vanish at Any Moment

text.content: "Su Qingyao let out a slight sigh of relief, her gaze toward Chen Ji carrying a new measure of approval. Though this废物师弟 had meager cultivation, he surprisingly understood how to assess the situation. She stepped forward, standing shoulder to shoulder with Chen Ji, her eyes scanning the entrance to the ruins before them, trying to find some clue."

choices.memory_label: 陈机展现出超乎年龄的冷静

choices.description: "First consult Mr. Mo from the Tianji Record Fragment, understand the ruins' situation before making a decision."
choices.risk_hint: "Mr. Mo may not tell the truth"

dialogue.content: "(An aged voice echoes in the sea of consciousness) Hmm... this ruin is indeed real. However, lad, are you certain you want to enter now?"

text.content: "Mr. Mo's voice carried a profound warning. Chen Ji's heart tightened, yet he did not back down. He knew he had no retreat—the whereabouts of the fourth page of the Tianji Record likely lay hidden within these ruins. Whether ahead lay dragon's pool or tiger's den, he had to step in."

choices.memory_label: 墨先生似乎知道遗迹的秘密

text.content: "As Chen Ji drew closer to the ruin's entrance, the blood resonance intensified. Luminous blue light swirled around him, like countless tiny streams pouring into his body. The Tianji Record Fragment in his sea of consciousness whipped frantically, those originally cryptic runes now lighting up one by one, like stars being ignited in sequence."

dialogue.content: "Wait! This aura on you... what's going on?"

text.content: "Su Qingyao's eyes flew open. She could clearly sense that something unbelievable was happening to Chen Ji—that aura was identical to what emanated from the ruin entrance, even purer, even more ancient. A preposterous thought flashed through her mind: what connection did this废物师弟 have with these ruins?"

"Yet Chen Ji had no time to concern himself with Su Qingyao's shock. His entire attention was captured by the hall slowly materializing before him. Deep within the luminous blue glow, he glimpsed an ancient stone door. Countless intricate runes carved its surface, their arrangement perfectly matching the runes on the Tianji Record Fragment in his mind."

choice.prompt: "The ancient stone door was right before him, its runes perfectly aligned with the Tianji Record. The light seeping through the door's seams flickered intermittently, as if waiting for something."

choices.description: "Since the door aligns so perfectly with the Tianji Record, push it open without hesitation."

text.content: "Chen Ji took a deep breath and raised his right hand to the ancient stone door. The moment his palm touched its surface, the runes blazed to life, the blinding light nearly forcing his eyes shut. The stone door let out a沉闷 roar and slowly slid open to both sides."

choices.description: "Invite Su Qingyao to enter together, the two of you watching each other's backs and reducing risk."

dialogue.content: Senior Sister Su, would you like to enter with me?
(A hint of surprise flickered in her eyes, then she nodded) Alright, I'll accompany you.

text.content: Su Qingyao's answer was unexpectedly direct. She stepped forward, standing shoulder to shoulder with Chen Ji, her gaze flickering with complex emotions. She knew she might be stepping into a massive whirlpool, but for some reason, she chose to trust this man who appeared to be a废物.

choices.description: Have Su Qingyao provide support outside while venturing alone into the ruins.

dialogue.content: Are you sure you want to go in alone?

text.content: Su Qingyao's brow furrowed tightly, her gaze toward Chen Ji carrying bewilderment and concern. This decision was too risky; everything within the ruins was unknown, entering alone was no different from seeking death. Yet Chen Ji merely smiled faintly, a smile carrying a deeper meaning she couldn't comprehend.

The moment the stone door fully opened, a vast, ocean-like aura rushed toward Chen Ji. His vision blurred, and he was swept into the gate by an invisible force. When he opened his eyes again, he found himself inside a massive hall. The walls around were carved with densely packed runes, each emanating a faint blue glow, illuminating the entire hall like a deep-sea palace.

In the center of the hall stood a stone platform, three chi tall, utterly still. Above the platform, an ancient book radiating golden light floated in mid-air. On its cover were three archaic characters in bold script—Tianji Record! Chen Ji's heart nearly stopped beating. The fourth page, the one he had searched for so long, actually appeared before his eyes.

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed once more in the consciousness sea) Be careful! This is not the true Tianji Record, but rather...

text.content: However, before Mo Xiansheng could finish, a sinister laugh echoed from the depths of the hall. The laughter reverberated through the empty hall, carrying a hint of mockery and playfulness, as if it had been waiting for a long time.

dialogue.content: Hehe... Chen Ji, this old man has been waiting for you for quite some time.

text.content: An elderly figure slowly walked out from the shadows. The person wore Tianqing Sect elder attire, their face withered, but their eyes were sharp as blades. Chen Ji's pupils constricted—the visitor was actually Tianqing Sect's former leader Ling Yuan! That old fox who appeared to treat him with utmost care on the surface but harbored treacherous intentions beneath. He should have realized earlier—how could ruins manifesting through a temporal rift have no traps whatsoever?

dialogue.content: What, surprised to see this old man? The Tianji Record's inheritor... no, perhaps I should say the chess piece, has finally arrived.

text.content: Ling Yuan's laughter echoed through the hall, those murky old eyes gleaming with greedy light. He stared at Chen Ji as if gazing upon a rare treasure. "This old man has schemed for decades, finally waiting for this day. The fourth page of the Tianji Record—it should belong to me!" His voice abruptly rose, "Chen Xuan, that废物, stole everything that belonged to me back then. Today, you'll repay this blood debt!"

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan's scheme is finally exposed. The fourth page of the Tianji Record lies right before him yet is filled with peril. This scheming opponent clearly came well prepared.

choices.description: Since we've撕破脸皮, I'll fight Ling Yuan honorably and let strength speak for itself.
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's cultivation runs deep and unfathomable

dialogue.content: (A cold smile curled at the corner of his lips) Senior Elder Ling sure puts on quite the show. Unfortunately... you've miscalculated one thing.

text.content: "Chen Ji's tone remained calm, yet danger flickered in his eyes. He slowly raised his right hand, the symbols of the Tianji Record Fragment faintly visible on his palm. 'Did you think I would walk into your trap without preparation?' His voice carried a hint of mockery. 'Old Patriarch Ling, we're both chess players here—why pretend to be so desperate?'"

choices.memory_label: 陈机展现出与修为不符的底气

choices.description: "Circumvent Ling Yuan, waiting for Su Qingyao's reinforcement or other variables to emerge."

dialogue.content: "Oh? Since Old Patriarch Ling says you've miscalculated one thing, why not share it with us?"

text.content: Chen Ji spoke unhurriedly, his tone carrying a hint of playfulness. He was gambling—betting that Su Qingyao wouldn't sit by and watch him face danger alone, betting that the Tianji Record Fragment still harbored some power he hadn't yet awakened, betting that Ling Yuan didn't know his true trump card. This kind of gamble where he put himself at the center, he had made countless times since childhood.

choices.description: "Desperately activate the foresight ability of the Tianji Record, viewing the fate trajectory within the next three hours."

text.content: Chen Ji's mind stirred, and the Tianji Record Fragment dramatically unfolded within his Mental Sea. Those golden symbols spun madly, and a blurry image gradually took shape—yet just as he was about to see it clearly, a blinding white light exploded outward, engulfing everything. The image was too blurry, as if some force was deliberately obscuring it.

dialogue.content: "(Mo Xiansheng's urgent voice) There's interference! The image is being blocked—this method, only the Holy Sect possesses!"

text.content: Chen Ji's heart tightened. The Holy Sect's interference, Chen Nian's existence, Ling Yuan's ambush... all the clues intertwined into a massive web at this moment, and he, it seemed, stood at the center of the web. The Tianji Record's foresight had deviated this severely for the first time—were this an accident, or some higher-level manipulation?

choices.memory_label: 天机录被圣宗力量干扰

text.content: Ling Yuan's laughter stopped abruptly. He stared at Chen Ji, a hint of apprehension flickering in his gaze. "You're quite composed." He said slowly, "But you think this will let you escape my grasp? This ruins have long been laid with traps by me—even if you had heaven-reaching abilities, today you'd be trapped without escape!" With that, he waved his sleeve, and dozens of formation patterns lit up from all directions, shrouding the entire great hall tightly.

Yet Chen Ji remained unmoved. He looked at Ling Yuan calmly, even a faint smile tugging at the corner of his lips. "Old Patriarch Ling, your formation is indeed exquisite, but unfortunately... you've miscalculated one thing." His voice was unhurried, "The Tianji Record chose me, not just because of my bloodline."

Ling Yuan's brow furrowed tightly, an ominous premonition rising in his heart. However, before he could react, an earth-shaking rumble echoed from outside the great hall. Immediately, a sharp sword light broke through the air, directly tearing apart a corner of his formation! Su Qingyao's figure swooped into the great hall like streaming light, her delicate hand waving, countless sword energies swept toward Ling Yuan like a storm!

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, I'm here to help you!"

text.content: Su Qingyao's voice was cold as frost, yet the emotion within it made Chen Ji's heart stir slightly. This proud woman had actually come to his aid despite the danger. He turned to look at her, and in that moment their eyes met, countless words passed between them without speaking. Ling Yuan's face had darkened to the extreme—he never expected his meticulously laid lethal trap to be effortlessly broken by a mere girl.

As the three parties stood in a stalemate, the golden ancient tome hovering above the stone platform suddenly burst forth with dazzling light. An aged yet majestic voice rang through the great hall: "The Hall of Heavenly Secrets reopens; the destined one shall claim it." Before the voice faded, the ancient tome transformed into streaming light, shooting straight toward Chen Ji's brow center! At the same time, Ling Yuan and Su Qingyao both moved—one wanting to seize it, the other wanting to intercept.
Chen Ji下意识地抬手，那道流光便径直没入了他的掌心。刹那间，一股磅礴的信息如洪水般涌入他的意识——那是天机录第四页的内容，记载着关于上古大劫的秘密，以及一个让他心惊胆战的名字：天道之眼！与此同时，他的脑海中响起墨先生的声音："第四页解封了，小子，你终于有资格知道一些真相了……"
